pairs: And the Lord spoke to Moses,
a calf for sin, two rams,
and a basket with unleavened bread,
et congregabis omnem cœtum ad ostium tabernaculi.
and gather together all the assembly at the door of the tabernacle.
And Moses did as the Lord had commanded.
Congregataque omni turba ante fores tabernaculi,
And when all the crowd was gathered together before the entrance of the tabernacle,
Iste est sermo, quem jussit Dominus fieri.
“This is the word that the Lord has ordered to be done.”
he brought forward Aaron and his sons.
And when he had washed them,
he vested the high priest with the linen undergarment,
wrapped him with the wide belt,
and clothed him with the hyacinth tunic,
and over it he imposed the ephod.
And tying it to the belt,
he fitted it to the breastplate,
on which was Doctrine and Truth.
Also, he wrapped the headdress on his head,
and over it, opposite the forehead,
posuit laminam auream consecratam in sanctificatione,
he placed the plate of gold, consecrated with sanctification,
just as the Lord had instructed him.
He also took up the oil of anointing,
with which he anointed the tabernacle,
quo linivit tabernaculum cum omni supellectili sua.
along with all of its articles.
Cumque sanctificans aspersisset altare septem vicibus,
And when he had sprinkled the altar seven times to sanctify it,
labrumque cum basi sua sanctificavit oleo.
And the washtub with its base he sanctified with the oil.
And pouring the oil over Aaron’s head,
filios quoque ejus oblatos vestivit tunicis lineis,
Likewise, after he had offered his sons, he vested them with linen tunics,
and wrapped them with wide belts,
just as the Lord had ordered.
He also offered the calf for sin.
cumque super caput ejus posuisset Aaron et filii ejus manus suas,
And when Aaron and his sons had placed their hands upon its head,
and dipping his finger in it,
he touched the horns of the altar all around.
And when it was expiated and sanctified,
fudit reliquum sanguinem ad fundamenta ejus.
he poured out the remainder of the blood at its base.
Adipem vero qui erat super vitalia,
the fat which was on the vital organs,
and the mesh of the liver,
and the two little kidneys with their fat,
And the calf with the skin,
just as the Lord had instructed.
He also offered a ram as a holocaust.
super cujus caput cum imposuissent Aaron et filii ejus manus suas,
And when Aaron and his sons had imposed their hands upon its head,
et fudit sanguinem ejus per circuitum altaris.
and he poured out its blood around the altar.
And cutting the ram into pieces,
and the fat in the fire,
having first washed the intestines and the feet.
totumque simul arietem incendit super altare,
And then he burned the whole of the ram upon the altar,
eo quod esset holocaustum suavissimi odoris Domino,
because it was a holocaust of most sweet odor to the Lord,
just as he had instructed him.
Obtulit et arietem secundum in consecratione sacerdotum,
He also offered the second ram, as a consecration of priests.
posueruntque super caput ejus Aaron et filii ejus manus suas:
And Aaron and his sons placed their hands upon its head.
And when Moses had immolated it,
taking up some of its blood,
he touched the tip of Aaron’s right ear,
and the thumb of his right hand,
He also offered the sons of Aaron.
cumque de sanguine arietis immolati tetigisset extremum auriculæ singulorum dextræ,
And when, from the blood of the ram which was immolated, he had touched the tip of the right ear of each one,
et pollices manus ac pedis dextri,
and the thumbs of their right hands, as well as their feet,
reliquum fudit super altare per circuitum:
he poured out the remainder upon the altar all around.
and all the fat that covers the intestines,
and the mesh of the liver,
et duos renes cum adipibus suis et armo dextro separavit.
and the two kidneys with their fat, and the right shoulder, he separated.
taking bread without leaven from the basket of unleavened bread,
and a cake sprinkled with oil,
he placed them upon the fat
tradens simul omnia Aaron et filiis ejus.
delivering all these to Aaron and his sons.
Qui postquam levaverunt ea coram Domino,
And when they had lifted them up in the sight of the Lord,
he received them again from their hands,
and he burned them upon the altar of holocaust,
because it was an oblation of consecration,
as a sweet odor of sacrifice to the Lord.
Tulitque pectusculum, elevans illud coram Domino,
And he took his portion from the ram of consecration,
de ariete consecrationis in partem suam,
and he lifted up its breast in the sight of the Lord,
just as the Lord had instructed him.
et sanguinem qui erat in altari,
and the blood that was on the altar,
aspersit super Aaron et vestimenta ejus,
he sprinkled it over Aaron and his vestments,
et super filios illius ac vestes eorum.
and over his sons and their vestments.
Cumque sanctificasset eos in vestitu suo,
And when he had sanctified them with their vestments,
“Cook the flesh before the entrance of the tabernacle,
which have been placed in the basket,
just as the Lord instructed me,
‘Aaron and his sons shall eat them.’
quidquid autem reliquum fuerit de carne et panibus,
Then whatever will remain of the flesh
and the loaves shall be consumed with fire.
De ostio quoque tabernaculi non exibitis septem diebus,
Also, you shall not exit from the door of the tabernacle for seven days,
usque ad diem quo complebitur tempus consecrationis vestræ;
until the day on which the time of your consecration shall be completed.
For in seven days the consecration is finished,
even as it has begun at this present time,
so that the rite of the sacrifice might be accomplished.
Day and night you shall remain in the tabernacle,
ac nocte manebitis in tabernaculo observantes custodias Domini,
observing the watches of the Lord,
For so it has been commanded to me.”
Feceruntque Aaron et filii ejus cuncta quæ locutus est Dominus per manum Moysi.
And Aaron and his sons did everything that the Lord spoke by the hand of Moses.
